_meta.title: Verbatim-vendored upstream sources
_meta.notes: Copies ai-kit took from an upstream repo and still ships largely as-is. Only VERBATIM copies belong here — distilled work (the lifecycle skills whose ideas came from mattpocock/skills, gstack, superpowers) is deliberately divergent and must NOT be resynced; see plugins-excluded.json for why. Each entry pins the upstream commit the copy was taken from, so bin/ai-kit-upstream-drift.sh can report when upstream has moved. `local_deltas` records edits ai-kit made on purpose — a re-vendor must reapply them, never clobber them. Field names match the external-rule frontmatter convention documented in VETTING.md.

sources.name: sandcastle-sequential-reviewer
sources.local_deltas: Two stack-agnostic patches, and nothing else — verified against the pin. main.mts: hardcoded `npm install` and `["node_modules"]` replaced with {{INSTALL_CMD}} / {{COPY_TO_WORKTREE}} placeholders, filled by bin/apply-sandcastle.sh from lockfile detection. implement-prompt.md: `npm run typecheck && npm run test` replaced with project-detected test/lint commands. CODING_STANDARDS.md, review-prompt.md and template.json are byte-identical to the pin. orchestration/sandcastle/main.ts.template is a byte-identical duplicate of main.mts (apply-sandcastle.sh copies the directory, then overwrites main.mts with the template) — re-vendor must update both. orchestration/sandcastle/prompt.md.template is NOT from upstream: it is ai-kit original, referencing CONTEXT.md / AGENTS.md and a {{TASK_DESCRIPTION}} upstream never had, so it is deliberately absent from `paths`.

sources.name: laravel-php-83-rule
sources.local_deltas: None in the body — ai-kit replaces upstream's own frontmatter (description/globs/alwaysApply) with its rule frontmatter and adds the do-not-edit-in-place banner. Re-pinned 2026-08-27 from 4467ad4: the repo HEAD had moved but zero commits touched this file, and the body compared identical, so only the pin advanced. The rule file carries the same pinned_sha in its own frontmatter — the two must be bumped together.
